order_plan.first_pass: Different reviewers, if available, independently start with opposite phases without seeing the other-phase anchors/ratings; a later within-reviewer second pass is explicitly repeated exposure.
carryover_controls: Save each first pass before the other-phase instructions or reconciliation are shown.
Specify and log any interval before a second phase; no untested interval guarantees washout.
Do not expose prior scores or prefill the other response. Reviewers may need the same PDF again, so memory cannot be eliminated.
Log sequence, dates, earlier exposure and any accidental cross-condition access.
Keep PathOS end context separate and balance its position if practicable; it is not a washout mechanism.
order_plan.if_only_one_reviewer: One sequence is a usability/calibration observation, not a counterbalanced experiment or independent phase-effect estimate.
order_plan.blindness_limit: Phase instructions must be visible to interpret the task; no claim of phase blinding. Project names/source dates remain visible.

unit_and_interpretation.AD4GD: The same exact DMP under two phase interpretations, not two independent DMPs or a longitudinal pair. Any paired condition labels identify calibration lens, not early/late source versions.
unit_and_interpretation.PathOS: A different project/document, proposed end-phase context; not the later version of AD4GD.
unit_and_interpretation.phase_comparability: Same AD4GD bytes hold source content constant, but requirements change by phase. Compare interpretation, evidence selection, applicability and anchors before any ordinal score contrast.
unit_and_interpretation.score_interpretation: 0/1/2 remains ordinal; neither equal score meanings across phases nor interval distances are established. No averaging across E/M to create a reference and no native 0-100 conversion.
unit_and_interpretation.denominators: Each condition retains 16 IDs; AD4GD-M has 15 defined cells plus one source-undefined 5d row. Do not use a fictitious 48 scored-row denominator.

wrapper_contract.future_adapter: Pending; create a versioned assessment record only from actual human responses under the existing record contract, preserving condition/phase/source provenance.
wrapper_contract.undefined_cell_handling: AD4GD-M/5d instrument_defined=false is source metadata only. Response remains not_entered/null with empty reasons/evidence; do not supply NA, uncertainty, a score or inherited early/end wording.
